Shri Shreyash Pandit - Advocate for respondent No.4.
 Order

This petition under Article 226 22 of Constitution of India has been filed seeking following reliefs:
"(i) To set aside the order impugned dated 02.08.2017 (Anx P/1) passed by the respondent No.2.
(ii) To allow the application U/s. 28 28-A(1) & (2) of Land Acquisition Act, 1894 (Anx P/4) filed by the petitioners.

(iii) Any other reliefs deemed fit to this Hon'ble Court on facts and circumstances of the instant case."
2. It is submitted by counsel for petitioners that the land of petitioners was acquired and by award dated 07.04.2006, compensation was paid.

On an application filed by another person, the trial Court enhanced the compensation amount and accordingly, petitioner petitioners filed an Krishna Mohan Tiwari vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 4 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/156506867/
1 application under Section 28-A 28 A of Land Acquisition Act, 1894 for re re- determination of amount of compensation on the basis of award of the NEUTRAL CITATION NO.

sentences.text: Merely because the award was passed by the Co Court under Reference eference on 29.10.2015 would not mean that application filed by petitioners could have been decided in the light of provisions of Act, 2013.

3. Counsel ounsel for respondents also submitted that once the acquisition was done under the provisions of Land Land Acquisition Act, 1894 1894, then the application for re-determination determination of award should have been considered in the light of provisions of Section 28-A A of Land Acquisition Act Act, 1894.

4. Heard the learned counsel for parties.
5.
It is not a case where compensation compensation was not paid or possession was not taken.
In other words, the provisions of Section 24 of Act, 2013 would not apply..

Therefore, Therefore, this Court is of considered opinion that Collector, Rewa committed a material illegality by treating this application underr the provisions of Act, 2013, whereas it should have been considered in the light of Section 28-A 28 A of Land Acquisition Act Act, 1894.
6. Accordingly, order dated 02.08.2017 passed by Collector, Rewa in case No. 38/A-74/2016 74/2016-17 is hereby quashed.
7. The matter is remanded back to Collector, Rewa to decide the application in accordance with the provisions of Section 28 28-A of Land Acquisition Act, 1894.

NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-JBP:54218 2024:MPHC 8. Since the award was passed in the year 2006 and 18 long years have passed and this petition is pending pending for the last 6 years, therefore, Collector, Rewa is directed to decide the application within a period of six months from the date of production of certified copy of this order.

9. Needless to mention that this Court has not considered the merits/demerits/entitlement erits/entitlement of petitioners petitioner and the application shall be decided strictly in accordance with law including the question of limitation.
10.
With aforesaid observation, observation the petition is allowed allowed.

(G.S. G.S. AHLUWALIA AHLUWALIA) JUDGE SR*
